text:
anya: New customer-driven ask from two pilots (AcmeHealth + Orchid). They want a compact console bundle: 1) dashboard templates for latency/cost/errors, 2) a small tracing-hook example + sampling policy, 3) an exportable cost breakdown and CSV.

mike: Can we scope a true-minimum MVP so eng/runtime doesn't become a blocker? I'm thinking: feature flag + a single prebuilt dashboard set + one trace hook and a tiny cost-breakdown endpoint.

rashid: For minimal runtime work, we can emit a metrics façade that pulls pre-aggregates and a lightweight trace extractor that tags root spans. Proposal:
- dashboards: latency heatmap, per-route cost sparkline, error waterfall (3 widgets)
- trace hook: single on-request middleware that sets attributes
- cost API: per-route daily delta + CSV export endpoint

sam: Acceptance gates (suggested):
- dashboard widget render p95 < 700ms on seeded test data
- trace hook overhead < 0.8ms median when run in-path
- cost CSV exports complete under 3s for 24h slice
- billing parity within 2% on synthetic billing run

jess: UX asks: make the dashboards importable (one-click template), add a small legend for quantization cost impact, and let teams tag routes by product-team in UI. Export button should include route tags as columns.

anya: Rollout plan suggestion: labs flag (feature: labs_console_v2) -> internal QA -> canary (AcmeHealth only) -> broaden to Orchid -> GA. Timeline: 4w labs build, 2w canary, 3w post-canary polishing.

mike: Risks: metrics ingestion spike from dashboard queries. Mitigation: pre-aggregate and memoize queries for labs tenants; cap dashboard refresh to 15s for trial tenants. Also need quota guard on CSV exports.

rashid: Sampling strategy idea: keep 100% of error traces, 2% of successes, and a head-sampling buffer of 500 unique prefixes to increase cache hits. Retention: labs raw traces 14d, pre-aggregates 45d. Post-GA defaults can be stricter. Need legal check for AcmeHealth (PHI) and EU data residency for Orchid.

sam: Launch criteria checklist (to be satisfied before canary):
- perf gates met in our synthetic harness
- 2 pilot customers able to run provided benchmark script
- docs + 1-page quickstart and code snippets published
- oncall runbook with fallback "lite metrics" view
- legal ok for PHI & residency

anya: Customers specifically asked for a small eval harness: steady ramp 200 -> 2k rps over 20m, with a token mix generator and an exported CSV of per-route cost at the end. Sam can draft scripts.

mike: For the tracing hook snippet (JS example):
```js
// attach customer and model info to span
const span = tracer.startSpan('request.root');
span.setAttribute('customer.id', customerId);
span.setAttribute('model.variant', variant);
// end span later
```

rashid: Implementation note: need to propagate those attributes into metrics pipeline. I'll prototype a small bridge that maps span attributes -> metric labels and emits to our pre-agg layer. Could be a 2-stage extractor: live tap -> buffered mapper -> pre-agg sink.

jess: Stretch items to consider (not required for initial labs): per-team route tagging UI, ability to schedule CSV reports, deeper quantization cost breakdown per-token class. Mark as "stretch" in spec.

infra-bot: deploy-scheduler: queued deploy for branch feature/labs_console_v2 at 1767012800; estimated maintenance window 45m.

anya: Next steps: rashid + mike to produce minimal schema + dashboard templates by Tue EOD; sam to prototype benchmark script; jess to make a quick UI import mock; I'll coordinate legal for PHI and EU residency. We'll gate canary on legal + perf. :white_check_mark:

mike: ack, will open PR for dashboard templates and add feature flag wiring.

rashid: ack, will start prototyping span->metric bridge and sampling config.

sam: ack, will draft benchmark harness and sample CSV output.

jess: ack, will mock import flow and export columns.

anya: note: keep labs_console_v2 strictly behind the flag. No customer-facing comms until after post-canary signoff.
